meaning: "AUM, salutations to Ardhanarishvara", the Lord who is half woman: Shiva and Shakti as one body.
purpose: To honour wholeness beyond the division of male and female.
when: On Monday, Shiva’s day, or whenever one needs to feel whole.
note: A simple nama-style devotional salutation, labelled as such: a name with namah, not a scriptural mantra with its own lineage.
source: Nama-style salutation, as given in the supplied library
name: AUM Ardhanarishvaraya Namah
